reason: The company secured a significant turnkey contract worth Rs 466.7 crore, which provides a clear boost to its order book and future revenue visibility.
why_now: The contract was officially disclosed in an exchange filing on October 10, 2026.
source_headlines: Viviana Power Tech Limited: Viviana Power Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about receiving a new turnkey contract aggregating to Rs. 466,73,61,738.00 (Rupees Four Hundred Sixty-Six Crore Seventy-Three Lakh Sixty-One Thousand Seven Hundred Thirty-Eight Only), inclusive of taxes, from existing client M/s. Madhya Gujarat Vij Company Limited (MGVCL).
